body:
### Summary

Hello uv folks.

In Fedora, we have triaged several already disclosed CVEs from pypa/virtualenv as they were reported to the uv package as well (reasons not important, happy to explain). With LLM (Claude Sonnet 5) I have found that CVE-2026-113732 is reproducible in uv 0.13.6 on Fedora Linux.

https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/commit/3bddeaf8d02c3ee7f576503efb082f8f494cfcab

uv's fish activate.fish script splices the same attacker-controlled prompt value, unescaped, inside a single-quoted fish string literal, so a single quote in the value breaks out of the literal and executes arbitrary fish code when the script is sourced.

    uv venv --prompt "x'; touch /tmp/PWNED; set x '" venv
    fish -c 'source venv/bin/activate.fish'
    ls /tmp/PWNED 

I have reported this to security at astral.sh but this does not constitute vulnerability within uv’s attacker and threat models, hence I am reporting this as a regular bug.

### Platform

Fedora Linux

### Version

0.13.6

### Python version

any
title: activate.fish runs commands from a path or prompt
